name: Dark Turquoise
lede: Dark Turquoise is a bright, saturated cyan-teal from the X11 color list, with little of the darkness its name suggests.

sections.title: A listed color
sections.body:
Paterson's dictionary lists DarkTurquoise as an entry in the X11 Color Set, with hex code 00CED1 [1]. In his index it is filed with the blues, not the greens [2]. Our name records list CSS, a web encyclopedia and the xkcd list of 2010 [3].

Despite the name, the swatch is bright and light, not dark [5]. Origin of the name undocumented in our sources.

Its nearest neighbors among our names, by CIELAB distance, are [[medium-turquoise|Medium Turquoise]], [[maximum-blue-green|Maximum Blue Green]] and [[tiffany-blue|Tiffany Blue]] [5]. On a white page it reaches a contrast ratio of 1.95:1 [5].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our archive of 23,781 paintings has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of this swatch covering at least 1% of its canvas, as photographed [4]. That describes the archive, not painting as a whole, and it says nothing against the color: it is a screen color first, and museum photographs rarely hold it.
